rubrics.criterion: A single cohesive abstraction (one data type or equivalent object) now represents the benchmark target's full identity — distribution flavor, distribution version, build revision, target id, target platform, and authentication style — and that representation, not six unrelated parameters, is what the preparation path hands between the sites that previously re-listed the facts.
rubrics.rationale: The task's core outcome is giving the always-together cluster facts one owning abstraction; a repair that only reorders or renames the loose values leaves the group without an owner.

rubrics.criterion: No function or method signature along the preparation path still declares the identity facts as the same group of neighbouring loose parameters; every occurrence of the pattern found by the solver was addressed, not only the first or the most convenient one.
rubrics.rationale: This repair spans several production signatures across modules; leaving even one occurrence of the repeatedly co-declared parameter group means the same maintenance hazard survives at that site.

rubrics.criterion: The inter-actor hand-off that reports a prepared track to race control carries the target cluster's identity as the cohesive representation (the message construction and the receiving side both use it), instead of unpacking and re-listing each fact individually at either end.
rubrics.rationale: The load-driver to race-control hand-off is the central crossing point of the path; if the message still spells the facts out one by one, the clump's most repeated interface survives the repair.

rubrics.criterion: The facts that a telemetry path derives on its own (from its own cluster query at benchmark start, independently of the driver) are gathered into the same cohesive representation when they are published as cluster meta-info.
rubrics.rationale: The telemetry area is a deliberate second, independent derivation of the exact same identity facts joined to this task; repairing only the driver/race-control chain and ignoring the telemetry publication resolves only part of the discovered scope.

rubrics.criterion: The bookkeeping that bridges engine setup and track-prepared completion on the driver side keeps the identity as the cohesive representation (or an equivalent single value), so the completion hand-off does not reassemble the identity from a batch of per-fact values that were staged one by one.
rubrics.rationale: That intermediate store is an occurrence of the same pattern in attribute-batch form: when it still stages six sibling values, every new fact again has to be added there by hand, which the task asks to eliminate.

rubrics.criterion: All in-repo call sites touched by the reshaping were updated consistently: senders pass the representation, receivers read it, and no in-repo caller still builds or unpacks the six facts individually in order to talk to a reshaped function.
rubrics.rationale: A data-clump repair is only sound as a whole path; a leftover caller that re-expands the values into a loose argument list silently re-introduces the pattern one hop away from the new abstraction.

rubrics.criterion: Documentation and docstrings that describe the old convention — parameter lists deliberately mirroring the fact lists used by the other paths so they can be kept in sync — were removed or rewritten once that convention no longer exists.
rubrics.rationale: The injected guidance to keep the loose lists in sync exists only because the values were loose; leaving it in place documents a convention the repair just removed and misleads the next maintainer.

rubrics.criterion: Exactly one representation of the benchmark target's identity was introduced for this path; the repair does not create a second parallel representation of the same facts (e.g. both a loose-value form and the cohesive object carried together through the same hop).
rubrics.rationale: With identity facts flowing through several modules, a repair can accidentally leave a converted shadow of the old data alongside the new abstraction, which recreates the synchronization burden the task removes.

rubrics.criterion: The repair leaves no dead ends from the old loose-value plumbing: no untouched per-fact attributes that nothing reads or writes anymore, no parameters of reshaped functions that callers no longer populate, and no helper whose only remaining purpose was to stage the six facts one by one.
rubrics.rationale: The loose form left per-fact attributes, forwarding helpers, and individually spelled parameters behind; a finished repair removes them instead of abandoning them in place.

rubrics.criterion: The diff does not retain compatibility scaffolding for code that no longer needs it — such as a forwarding shim that accepts the six facts individually and merely repackages them, kept only so a call site could stay unmodified.
rubrics.rationale: Inside this codebase every caller is updatable, so a six-parameter adapter that exists only to translate between the old form and the new representation is leftover scaffolding, not a required bridge.

rubrics.criterion: The cluster-scoped meta-info written at benchmark start is unchanged from before the repair: the same keys, in the same order, with statement-level conditionality preserved (build revision, version, and flavor first; the target identifier and the authentication style only when known; the platform always recorded).
rubrics.rationale: Dashboards and stored race meta-info key off exact keys and ordering; coalescing the facts into one object makes it easy to accidentally start writing missing values (e.g. a null platform or auth type) or to reorder the writes.

rubrics.criterion: Race-record update semantics are preserved: flavor, version, and revision still overwrite unconditionally, while a repair that lets an unknown (null) target identifier, platform, or authentication style overwrite previously recorded values regresses this item.
rubrics.rationale: The race object is created before the cluster facts are known and several pipelines lack platform or auth information; a bundled object makes blanket assignment the tempting one-liner, which would wipe facts recorded earlier.

rubrics.criterion: Every derivation and fallback rule for the identity facts survived the repair: the oss flavor/version/revision fallback when the cluster is not queried (skipped REST check, static responses, serverless with a public user), the serverless version number and operator build-hash overrides, the hosted-cluster header detection for the platform, and API-key-before-basic precedence for the authentication style.
rubrics.rationale: Re-shaping the carriers touches the code that computes each fact; silently dropping a conditional or a precedence rule only shows up on the exact pipelines (serverless, hosted, static-response) that the suite exercises lightly.

rubrics.criterion: The lifecycle behavior around the hand-off is unchanged: the target identity still reaches race control only after track preparation has completed, the race is still recorded and stored before the benchmark starts, and the console output about the race is the same.
rubrics.rationale: Moving values into a carried object invites moving the code too (e.g. recording earlier or later, or reordering the initial race store); those orderings are observable to users and downstream consumers of the race store.
